Shri Justice
Achal Kumar Paliwal

On The 7 th Of August, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 32388 of 2025
 Rajeev Lochan Pandey @Sonu
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh

Appearance:
 Shri Alok Tiwari - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Gitesh Singh Thakur - G.A. appearing on behalf of

ORDER This is first bail application filed on behalf of applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
2.

The applicant is in jail since 5.06.2025 in connection with Crime No.319/2023 registered at P.S.
Saman, District- Rewa, for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 411/34 of IPC.

3. Prosecution story, in brief is that applicant as well as co-accused persons went to one ATM and co-accused exchanged ATM of complainant and thereafter withdrew an amount from account of complainant through ATM and allegation against present applicant is that he was waiting with motorcycle out side ATM.
4.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 5.6.2025.
It is urged that Co-accused persons have been released on bail by Trial Court.
Applicant's bail application has been dismissed on the ground of criminal antecedents.
There is no direct and legal evidence against present applicant.
There is no TIP, no CCTV footage and no recovery has been made from present applicant.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:37106 2 MCRC-32388-2025 pending the trial.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.
6. Having regard to facts and circumstance of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently, first bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9 . Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately/forthwith to applicant through concerned jail Superintendent.
10. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed off.
11. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE sm Rajeev Lochan Pandey @Sonu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194916472/
